candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 because its downstream call to order (/v1/orders) fails with 502; the order service is the failing dependency, not the gateway itself.
candidates.uncertainty: Gateway logs show order returning 502 but not the underlying order-side failure cause; root cause may lie deeper in order's dependencies.

report.explanation: All checkout 502s correlate with gateway client calls to order returning 502 in ~60-100ms, indicating fast downstream failure at order. Gateway itself is healthy (readyz 200). Root cause is at or below order; evidence for order internals is absent, so confidence is moderate.
